SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
Section 1, Special Br., Station 775
REPORT
Date May 3, 1940.

Subject (in full) Alexander Crombie - enquiry from Passport & Registration Office,
British Consulate-General.

Made by D.S.I. MacAdie Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

With reference to attached enquiry from the
Passport and Registration Officer, British Consulate
General, a search of Municipal Police and other
records for the past ten years has failed to
reveal any trace of an Alexander Crombie, or in
fact any person of that surname.

R W Mac Adie
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

报告
日期：1940年5月3日。

事由（全称）亚历山大·克龙比（Alexander Crombie）——英国总领事馆护照与注册处的查询。

由副督察长麦克阿迪（MacAdie）呈报，经督察长克劳福德（Crawford）转递

关于随附的英国总领事馆护照与注册官的查询，经查阅过去十年的工部局警务处及其他档案记录，未发现任何名为亚历山大·克龙比（Alexander Crombie）者的踪迹，事实上也未发现任何姓此姓氏的人员。

R W 麦克阿迪
副督察长

助理 commissioner （特务科）

PASSPORT & REGISTRATION OFFICE.
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 259,
SHANGHAI. 9995
30th April, 1940. 5 110

Dear Mr. Yorke,

I enclose herein one more letter
enquiring as to the whereabouts of a missing person.
This time it is a niece enquiring as
to her uncle, Alexander Cromble.
I regret we have no record of this
uncle on our files. Can you assist me please?. I
apologise for worrying you with these enquiries, but
I am very grateful indeed for your help.

Yours sincerely,

R.W. Yorke, Esq.,
Deputy Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

D.S.J.

亲爱的约克先生：

兹随函附上另一封关于查询一名失踪人员下落的信件。
此次是一位侄女查询其叔父亚历山大·克伦布尔（Alexander Cromble）的下落。
很遗憾，我方档案中并无此叔父的记录。能否请您协助？对于以这些查询打扰您，我深表歉意，但对您的帮助我实在感激不尽。

此致
敬礼，

R.W. 约克 先生，
副总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

D.S.J.

GENUINE
Ferdinand Ruggiero
BEAUTY PREPARATIONS
111 SUMMER STREET
BOSTON, MASS.

March 20, 1940.

H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai, China.

Honorable:-

My father William E. Crombie has a
brother Alexander Crombie that he has not heard
from for years, and his age would be about 78 years.
Last week I was speaking to a young
lady that is a stenographer in the Standard Oil Co.,
in Shanghai.
This lady informed me that their is a
family by the name of Crombie in Shanghai, and his
first name is Alexander.
This Alexander Crombie which is my
father's brother. His mother's maiden name was
Isabella Patten Devine Crombie, and his father's
name William Richard Crombie.
If this should be the person would
you kindly let me know.
Awaiting your reply,
Cordially yours,
(SIGNED) Isabella J. Crombie.

1940年3月20日。

英国驻华总领事馆，
中国上海。

尊敬的先生：

家父威廉·E·克龙比（William E. Crombie）有一位兄弟名叫亚历山大·克龙比（Alexander Crombie），已多年未有音讯，其年龄约为78岁。
上周我与一位在上海美孚石油公司（Standard Oil Co.）担任速记员的年轻女士交谈。
这位女士告知我，上海有一户姓克龙比的人家，其名字为亚历山大。
这位亚历山大·克龙比即是我父亲的兄弟。其母亲婚前的姓名为伊莎贝拉·帕滕·德瓦恩·克龙比（Isabella Patten Devine Crombie），父亲的名字为威廉·理查德·克龙比（William Richard Crombie）。
若此人确系所寻之人，恳请告知。
静候回复，
此致
敬礼，
（签名）伊莎贝拉·J·克龙比。
